beats.say: You don't need one thousand subscribers to get paid on YouTube. Five hundred can be enough.
It's the expanded YouTube Partner Program.
Fans can pay you through memberships, Super Thanks, Super Chat and Shopping.

show.top: At *500 subscribers*, fans can pay you through

beats.say: You need five hundred subscribers, three public uploads in ninety days,
and either three thousand watch hours in a year or three million Shorts views in ninety days.
It suits tutorial, gaming and niche channels. The catch: no ad revenue yet, eligible countries only, and review takes about a month.

show.heading: *THE CATCH*
items: No ad revenue at this tier

beats.say: Send this to a creator friend on YouTube, and follow for one income stream every day.
